gloss: liquid crystal display panel; LCD panel

definitions.gloss: liquid crystal display panel; LCD panel
definitions.explanation: A flat display panel that uses liquid crystals to produce images, used in televisions, monitors, smartphones, and many other electronic devices.

examples.japanese: {液晶|えきしょう}パネルが{壊|こわ}れた。
この{会社|かいしゃ}は{大型|おおがた}{液晶|えきしょう}パネルを{製造|せいぞう}している。
examples.english: This company manufactures large LCD panels.

examples.japanese: スマートフォンの{液晶|えきしょう}パネルを{割|わ}ってしまい、{修理|しゅうり}に{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I cracked my smartphone's LCD panel and sent it in for repair.

notes:
Composed of {液晶|えきしょう} (liquid crystal) and パネル (panel, from English). The term {液晶|えきしょう} itself combines {液|えき} (liquid) and {晶|しょう} (crystal). LCD panels are found in nearly all modern flat-screen devices, and Japanese electronics companies have historically been major producers. In everyday conversation, people also say {液晶|えきしょう}{画面|がめん} (LCD screen) to refer to the visible screen area itself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {液晶|えきしょう}パネルが{割|わ}れる: the LCD panel cracks
- {液晶|えきしょう}パネルを{交換|こうかん}する: to replace the LCD panel
- {大型|おおがた}{液晶|えきしょう}パネル: large LCD panel
- {液晶|えきしょう}パネルを{搭載|とうさい}する: to be equipped with an LCD panel

RELATED WORDS:
- {液晶|えきしょう}: liquid crystal
- {液晶|えきしょう}テレビ: LCD television
- {液晶|えきしょう}{画面|がめん}: LCD screen
- {有機|ゆうき}EL: OLED — an alternative display technology
- {画面|がめん}: screen (general term)
